svg.title: Pixels, keypoints and particles as three state representations
svg.desc: Three panels of the same scene. The first is a dense pixel grid the model must predict in full. The second is a rigid box with eight tracked landmarks. The third is an unordered cloud of particles joined by short interaction edges.
svg.text: What is s? Three answers, and what each one lets the dynamics model be
The planner is the same in all three; the distance in the planning objective is measured
in whichever of these spaces the state lives, which is why the choice decides the result.
